title: THE GOD WHO NEVER FAILS
text: Beloved, I greet you in the matchless name of our Lord Jesus Christ. >> [music] >> I want you to understand that you are not here by accident this morning. The spirit of the living God has orchestrated this divine moment, and I prophesy to you that as you open your heart to the word of the Lord, something unusual is going to happen in your life. The Bible says in Psalm 5:2-3, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up." This is your morning of divine visitation. I want to talk to you about the God who never fails. Lift up your hands wherever you are and begin to worship him. For the scripture declares in Numbers 23:19, "God is not a man that he should lie, neither the son of man that he should repent. Hath he said, and shall he not do it? Or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?" [music] You see, we serve a God whose track record is impeccable. He has never failed anyone, and I decree that he will not start with you in the name of Jesus. When we talk about the God who never fails, we are addressing the very foundation of our faith. Everything in your Christian experience, everything in your pursuit of [music] destiny, everything in your walk with God is predicated on the understanding that our God is faithful. The Bible says in 1 Corinthians 1:2-9, "God is faithful by whom you were called unto the fellowship of his son Jesus Christ our Lord." This morning, I want you to catch something in the realm of the spirit. The faithfulness of God is not dependent on your performance. It is rooted in his nature. It is who he is. You know, many believers struggle in their walk with God because they have made God's faithfulness subject to their works. But beloved, God's faithfulness precedes your existence. Before you were born, he was faithful. Long after you have transitioned, he will remain faithful. The scripture says in 2 Timothy 2:13, "If we believe not, yet he abided faithful. He cannot deny himself." Do you understand what this means? God cannot be unfaithful because it would violate his nature. Unfaithfulness is foreign to the character of God. This morning I want to build your faith on the immutability of God. In Malachi 3:2-6 God declares, "For I am the Lord, I change not. Therefore, you sons of Jacob are not consumed." Our God does not change. He is the same yesterday, today, and forever. The God who parted the Red Sea is the same God who is listening to your prayers this morning. The God who shut the mouth of lions in Daniel's time is the same God who will silence every voice speaking against your destiny. The God who raised Lazarus from the dead is the same God who will resurrect every dead situation in your life. I need you to share this word with someone. There are people in your circle of influence who are about to give up on God. There are believers who are on the verge of abandoning their faith because they feel God has disappointed them. Share this message with them. Let them know that our God never fails. The apparent delay is not a denial. The scripture says in Habakkuk 2:2-3, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tarry, wait for it because it will surely come, it will not tarry." When Abraham was called by God, he was promised a seed. The Bible says in Genesis 15 that God took him out and showed him the stars and said, "So shall thy seed be." But 25 years passed before Isaac was born. Can you imagine waiting for 25 years? Many of us cannot even fast for 3 days without complaining, but Abraham believed God. The scripture says in Romans 4:22-21, "He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief, but was strong in faith, giving glory to God, and being fully persuaded that what he had promised, he was able also to perform." I want you to catch something this morning. Your faith in God's faithfulness is not determined by what you see in the natural. It is anchored in the character of God. Abraham did not consider his own body now dead, neither did he consider the deadness of Sarah's womb. He looked beyond the natural circumstances and [music] focused on the supernatural ability of God. And the Bible says that his faith was counted on to him for righteousness. There is a dimension of faith that God is calling you into this morning. It is the faith that refuses to judge God by temporary circumstances. It is the faith that says, "Though he slay me, yet will I trust him." Job understood this dimension when everything was stripped [music] away from him, his children, his wealth, his health, he still declared in Job 13:15, "Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him, but I will maintain mine own ways before him." This is the kind of faith that moves the heart of God. You see, beloved, God is looking for believers who will trust him even in the valley. Anybody can praise God on the mountain. Anybody can worship God when everything is going well, but can you worship him in the storm? Can you trust him in the wilderness? Can you believe him when everything around you is saying he has failed? This is the test of genuine faith. The three Hebrew boys understood this principle. When they were about to be thrown into the fiery furnace, they declared in Daniel 3:17-18, "If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king. But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou has set up." Did you see what they did? They affirmed God's ability, but they also declared their commitment to him regardless of the outcome. This morning I prophesy that God is raising a generation of believers who will not serve him because of what they can get from him, but because of who he is. The scripture says in Habakkuk 3:17-18, "Although the fig tree shall not blossom, [music] neither shall food be in the vines. The labor of the olive shall fail, and the field shall yield no meat. The flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls. [music] Yet, I will rejoice in the Lord. I will joy in the God of my salvation." Can you make that declaration this morning? Can you say even if my circumstances do not change, [music] I will still worship God? Because when you reach that level of consecration, you have accessed a dimension where disappointment cannot exist. How can you be disappointed in a God you are not serving for benefits? How can you lose faith in a God you trust because of his character and not his blessings? Now, let me show you something powerful about the God who never fails. In Exodus 3, when God appeared to Moses in the burning bush and commissioned him to go and deliver Israel, Moses asked a very important question. He said in Exodus 3:13, "Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel and shall say unto them, the God of your fathers has sent me unto you, and they shall say to me, 'What is his name?' What shall I say unto them?" And God gave a revelation that will change everything. He said in Exodus 3:14, "I am that I am." And he said, "Thus shall thou say unto the children of Israel, 'I am hath sent me unto you.'" Do you understand what God was revealing? He was saying, "I am the self-existent one. I am the one who was not created. I am the one who needs nothing to exist. I am the beginning and the ending. I am the alpha and the omega." When God says I am, he's declaring his eternal present. He's not bound by time. He's not limited by space. He exists outside the realm of human limitations. This is why he never fails. How can a God who sees the end from the beginning fail? How can a God who knows all things before they happen make mistakes? How can a God WHO HAS ALL POWER in heaven and in earth be unable to fulfill his promises? The scripture says in Psalm 115:2-3, "But our God is in the heavens. He hath done whatsoever he hath pleased." Nothing can stop God from accomplishing his purposes. I want you to open your mouth right now and begin to worship the God who never fails. Say, "Lord, I thank you because you are faithful. I thank you because your promises are yes and amen. I thank you because you cannot lie. I thank you because what you have spoken concerning my life must come to [music] pass." Keep worshipping him. The Bible says that God inhabits the [music] praises of his people. When you praise him, you are creating an atmosphere for his presence to manifest. Now, while you are worshipping him, I want to pray for you. But before we go into this prayer session, I want to share this word one more time because the anointing upon it is strong. Share this message with your family, with your friends, with your church members. There [music] are people who need to hear that our God never fails. In a world filled with disappointments and broken promises, they need to know that there is a God who keeps his word. Let me show you how the faithfulness of God operates in different dimensions. In Deuteronomy 7:2-9, the Bible says, "Know therefore that the Lord thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep [music] his commandments to a thousand generations." Did you see that? God's faithfulness extends to a thousand generations. This means that the covenant God made with Abraham is still active today. The promises God gave to your forefathers in faith are still valid in your life. When God makes a covenant, he backs it up with his character. The Bible says in Hebrews 6:13-14, "For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he swore by himself, saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee." God swore by himself because there is no higher authority to guarantee his promises. When God swears by himself, it is [music] settled. This morning I decree that every promise God has made concerning your life is settled. It does not matter how long it has taken. It does not matter what the enemy has done to try to stop it. God's word will surely come to pass in the name of Jesus. The scripture says in Isaiah 55:11, "So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth. It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it." You need to understand something about God's word. It is not ordinary speech. It is creative power. When God speaks, worlds are formed. When God declares, impossibilities [music] bow. When God pronounces, circumstances align. The Bible says in Psalm 33:9, "For he spake and it was done. He commanded and it stood fast." God's word carries executive authority in the realm of the spirit. This is why Jesus said in Matthew 24:35, "Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my word shall not pass away." The word of God is more permanent than creation itself. The mountains may crumble, the seas may dry up, the sun may cease to shine, but the word of God will stand forever. And if God has spoken a word concerning your life, that word is more real than your current circumstances. [music] I prophesy to you this morning that you will begin to see the manifestation of God's word in your life. Every prophetic word that has been spoken over you will come to pass. Every promise that God has given you in your secret place of prayer will materialize. Every vision that God has shown you concerning your future will become your present reality in the name of Jesus. But you need to understand the principle of faith. The Bible says in Hebrews 11:21, "Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen." Faith gives substance to the invisible. Faith makes the future present. Faith brings heaven to earth. Without faith, it is impossible to please God. The scripture says in Hebrews 11:6, "But without faith, it is impossible to please him. For he that cometh to God must believe that he is >> [music] >> and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him." Your faith in the faithfulness of God is [music] what activates his promises in your life. God has already spoken. His word is already established in heaven, but it needs your faith to manifest on earth. This is why the devil fights your faith so aggressively. He knows that if you believe God, nothing shall be impossible unto [music] you. Look at the woman with the issue of blood in Mark 5. She had been sick for 12 years. She had spent all her money on physicians, but instead of getting better, she grew worse. Can you imagine the level of disappointment she must have experienced? 12 years of hoping, believing, spending, and yet no change. But the Bible says in Mark 5:27-28, "When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment. For she said, 'If I may touch but his clothes, >> [music] >> I shall be whole.'" What activated her healing? Her faith. Despite 12 years of failure, despite all the disappointments, despite the natural impossibility of her situation, she [music] believed. And Jesus said to her in Mark 5:34, "Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole. Go in peace and be whole of thy plague." Her faith connected her to the God who never fails. This morning, I want you to reach out in faith and touch the hem of his garment. I don't care what you have been through. I don't care how many times you have tried and failed. I don't care how impossible your situation looks. The God who healed the woman with the issue of blood is the same God who is present with you right now. Reach out and touch him by faith. Now, let us go into [music] this prayer with understanding. This is not just an ordinary prayer. This is a militant prayer session. This is a prophetic prayer engagement. This is a moment where heaven and earth collide. >> [music] >> I want you to pray with your whole heart. The Bible says in Jeremiah 29:13, "And ye shall seek me and find me when ye shall search for me with all your heart." God is looking for wholehearted seekers. Lift up your hands wherever you are. If you are driving, pull over safely. If you are at home, find a place where you can focus. If you are at work, step aside for a few minutes. This is your moment of encounter with the God who never fails. Open your mouth and begin to pray. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace this morning. I thank you because you are the God who never fails. I thank you because your faithfulness reaches onto the clouds. I thank you because your promises are yes and amen. Lord, I worship you because you are not a man that you should lie, neither the son of man that you should repent. Father, I decree and declare that every word you have spoken concerning my life must come to pass. Every prophetic utterance that has been released over my destiny must manifest. Every promise that you have given me in the secret place of prayer must materialize in the name of Jesus. Lord, I refuse to judge you by my current circumstances. I refuse to measure your faithfulness by what I see in the natural. I choose to believe your word above my situation. I pray for every person who is receiving this word this morning. I decree that their faith is being strengthened right now in the name of Jesus. Lord, remove every doubt, every fear, every unbelief from their hearts. Let them know beyond any shadow of doubt that you are faithful. Let them experience your faithfulness in a tangible way. Let them see your hand moving in their lives. Father, I pray for those who have been waiting for long periods of time for their breakthrough. Lord, let them know that delay is not denial. Let them understand that your timing is perfect. Like Abraham who waited 25 years, let their faith remain strong. Like Joseph who spent 13 years in preparation, let them trust your process. Like Moses who spent 40 years in the wilderness before his assignment, let them know that you are preparing them for greatness. I come against every spirit of discouragement in the name of Jesus. I bind every voice that is telling them that God has forgotten them. I silence every thought that suggests that God has abandoned them. I decree that they will experience the manifestation of your faithfulness in a [music] dimension they have never known before. Lord, I pray for those who are dealing with health challenges. I decree divine healing in the name of Jesus. By the stripes of Jesus, they are healed. Every sickness, every disease, every infirmity must bow to the name of Jesus. Let the same power that raised Christ from the dead quicken their mortal bodies. Let them experience supernatural restoration. Let doctors be amazed at what God has done in their bodies. I pray for those who are facing financial difficulties. I decree supernatural provision in the name of Jesus. Lord, you are Jehovah Jireh, the God who provides. Open the windows of heaven and pour out blessings that they will [music] not have room enough to receive. Let them experience divine favor in their businesses, in their careers, in their endeavors. Let doors that have been shut be opened. Let opportunities that have been blocked be released. Father, I pray for those who are believing you for marriage. I decree that you will connect them with their divine spouse in the name of Jesus. Lord, orchestrate divine connections. Bring them together with the right person at the right time. Let their union be blessed and ordained by heaven. Let them experience covenant relationship that reflects your faithfulness. I pray for those who are trusting you for children. I decree that the barren shall be fruitful in the name of Jesus. Like Sarah, like Hannah, like Elizabeth, let them carry the fruit of the womb. Let every medical report that says it is impossible be overturned. Let them experience the miracle of conception and safe delivery. Lord, I pray for those who are facing spiritual battles. I decree victory in the name of Jesus. Every weapon formed against them shall not prosper. Every tongue that rises against them in judgment shall be condemned. I command every demonic assignment [music] to be frustrated. I decree that they walk in the authority that Christ has given them. Let them operate in dominion and power. Father, I pray for those [music] who are pursuing educational goals. I decree supernatural wisdom and understanding in the name of Jesus. Let them excel in their studies. Let them pass their examinations with outstanding results. Let [music] doors of opportunity be opened to them. Let them fulfill their academic destiny. I pray for those who are believing you for breakthrough in their careers. I decree promotion and elevation in the name of Jesus. Let them be favored by those in authority. Let their gifts make room for them. Let them be positioned in places of influence and impact. Let them fulfill their professional calling. Lord, I pray for those who are dealing with family challenges. [music] I decree restoration in the name of Jesus. Let peace return to their [music] homes. Let love be rekindled in their marriages. Let prodigal children return home. Let broken relationships be healed. Let their families become testimonies [music] of your faithfulness. Father, I pray for those who are dealing with legal battles. I decree divine intervention in the name of Jesus. Let justice prevail in their cases. Let every false witness be exposed. Let every evil counsel be frustrated. Let them experience victory in the courtroom. Let their adversaries be put to shame. I pray for those who are facing persecution because of their faith. I decree divine protection in the name of Jesus. Let no weapon formed against them prosper. Let them be bold and courageous in their testimony. Let their persecution turn into promotion. Let their trial become their triumph. Lord, I pray for those who are struggling with addictions. I decree freedom in the name of Jesus. Let every chain be broken. Let every stronghold be pulled down. Let them walk in the liberty that Christ has purchased for them. Let them be delivered completely and permanently from every bondage. Father, I pray for those who are dealing with depression and anxiety. I decree peace in the name of Jesus. Let your peace that passes all understanding guide their hearts and minds. Let every spirit of heaviness be lifted. Let them be clothed with the garment of praise. Let joy flood their souls. I pray for those who are believing you for restoration. I decree that what the enemy has stolen shall be returned sevenfold in the name of Jesus. Let them experience the fulfillment of Joel 2:25. And I will restore to you the years that the locusts have eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpillar, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you. Lord, I pray for those who are in ministry. I decree fresh anointing in the name of Jesus. Let your power rest upon them. Let them operate in signs, wonders, and miracles. Let souls be saved through their ministry. Let lives be transformed. Let their ministry be a demonstration of your faithfulness. Father, I thank you because you are answering these prayers. I thank you because you are the God who never fails. I decree that everyone who has participated in this prayer session will have a testimony of your faithfulness [music] in the name of Jesus. Let signs and wonders follow them. Let miracles become their portion. Let your glory be manifested in their lives. I seal every prayer with the blood of Jesus. I decree that it is done in heaven and it shall be done on earth. I declare that we shall see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living. We shall not die but live to declare the works of the Lord. Our latter end shall be greater than our beginning. I prophesy to you this morning that your season of waiting is over. Your season of manifestation has begun. What you have been believing God for shall come to pass speedily. Every delay is broken. Every obstruction is removed. Every hindrance is destroyed. The God who never fails is about to show himself strong on your behalf. In the name of Jesus, I declare that you are stepping into a new dimension of God's faithfulness. What you are about to experience will erase every doubt from your heart. What you are about to see will establish your faith forever. What God is about to do for you will become a testimony that will strengthen others. The scripture says in Psalm 37:25, "I have been young and now I'm old, yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread. This is a testimony from David who walked with God for many years. He never saw God fail the righteous. And I declare over your life that you will never be forsaken. You will never beg for bread. The God who has been faithful to every generation will be faithful to you. Remember the words of Joshua in Joshua 23:14, "And behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth, and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the Lord your God spake concerning you. All are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof." At the end of his life, Joshua could testify that God had not failed him in anything. I prophesy that you will have the same testimony. As you go from this place, carry this word in your heart. Meditate on it day and night. Let it become your confession. Let it build your faith. Let it anchor your soul. And whenever the enemy tries to make you doubt God's faithfulness, remember this morning. Remember what the spirit of God has spoken. Remember that you serve the God who never fails. I bless you in the name of Jesus. I decree that you are blessed coming in and blessed going out. You are blessed in the city and blessed in the field. You are the head and not the tail. You are both only and not beneath. You are blessed with [music] every spiritual blessing in heavenly places in Christ Jesus. The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face shine upon you and be gracious unto you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen and amen.
